exercises.prompt: Reading comprehension. Lis le texte : Every Saturday, Amina helps her aunt at the market in Bafoussam. They sell vegetables and fruit. Last Saturday, a customer left her bag at their stall. Amina found it and ran after her. “Madam, you forgot your bag!” she shouted. The woman thanked her and gave her a small gift. Amina's aunt said, “You are honest, my child.”

parts.prompt: Where does Amina help her aunt ?
The customer forgot her bag. Vrai ou faux ?
What does « it » refer to in « Amina found it » ?
Find a word in the text meaning « sincere / who does not steal ».
Why did the woman give Amina a gift ? Answer in one full sentence in your own words.
parts.model: Because Amina returned her lost bag.
parts.explanation: Voir le corrigé modèle et les critères de notation.

exercises.prompt: Use of English (cloze). Complète : Last year, Boris ____ (1) in Douala. He has ____ (2) English since 2020. If he works hard, he ____ (3) pass his exams. The letter ____ (4) by his teacher yesterday. “The boy ____ (5) bag was stolen is crying.”

Transformations. Réécris sans changer le sens : (1) “I am hungry,” she said. (2) Although it was raining, we went out. (3) Open your books, the teacher told us. (4) I am not rich, so I can't buy a car. (If…)

choices: She said that she is hungry.
She said that she was hungry.
She said that I was hungry.
She said me that she was hungry.
Despite it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
Because of the rain, we went out.
Despite the rain, but we went out.
The teacher told us open our books.
The teacher told us to open our books.
The teacher said us to open the books.
The teacher asked that we open.
If I am rich, I could buy a car.
If I would be rich, I can buy a car.
If I were rich, I can buy a car.
If I were rich, I could buy a car.
parts.explanation: type 2 : If + were, could / would + base.

exercises.prompt: Vocabulary. Associe chaque mot à son sens (2 points).
Guided composition. Écris à un ami (80 à 100 mots) pour lui parler de ton école et l'inviter à ton anniversaire (date, lieu, heure). Structure : salutation, corps, fermeture.
exercises.model: Dear Boris, How are you? I hope you are fine. My school is big and clean. I study English, maths and history, and my favourite teacher is Mr Nkeng. I'm writing to invite you to my birthday party on Saturday at 3 p.m. at my house. We will eat and play games. Please come. Write soon. Best wishes, Amina
exercises.explanation: Voir le corrigé modèle et les critères de notation.
